g.text: Full linear color range, no magnitude clipping. Blue = row lower; red = row higher. Diagonal omitted.
Archived losses: 30,087 series x 24 months; 3-seed mean losses. Eight configurations use revived checkpoints.
Statistical assumptions and provenance limits: results/gallery/README.md. Full-precision values: tables/all_pairwise_tests.csv.
